subject: which one?
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
Which games did you play?  You mean you got bored with the first Half Life game?  Or the first level in Portal?  If you haven't given Portal an honest 1 - 2 hours to get the hang of it, and roll through a couple levels, you're really missing out.  I guess if puzzles aren't your type of game I can see how you might not like it, but just the humor and sarcasm in Portal is worth it.  Some of that stuff is really twisted.  Has anyone else ever played a game with such a Passive/Agressive personality complex?

CAPS LOCK - Cruise control for AWESOME!!
